lines.text: Is a scar still skin? Look closer, thread by thread.
lines.phonemes: ɪz ɐ skˈɑː stˈɪl skˈɪn? lˈʊk klˈəʊsə, θɹˈɛd baɪ θɹˈɛd.

lines.text: Under the surface, most of your skin's strength is collagen, woven over and under in every direction like a basket, so it gives a little whichever way it's pulled.
lines.phonemes: ˌʌndə ðə sˈɜːfɪs, mˈəʊst əv jɔː skˈɪnz stɹˈɛŋθ ɪz kˈɒləʤən , wˈəʊvən ˌəʊvə and ˌʌndəɹ ɪn ˈɛvɹɪ daɪɹˈɛkʃən lˈaɪk ɐ bˈaskɪt, sˌəʊ ɪt ɡˈɪvz ɐ lˈɪtəl wɪtʃˈɛvə wˈeɪ ɪts pˈʊld.

lines.text: Cut through it, and the body doesn't reweave. It patches, laying new threads side by side, all in one direction, and leaves out the hair and the sweat glands.
lines.phonemes: kˈʌt θɹˈuː ɪt, and ðə bˈɒdi dˈʌzənt ɹɪwˈiːv. ɪt pˈatʃɪz, lˈeɪɪŋ njˈuː θɹˈɛdz sˈaɪd baɪ sˈaɪd, ˈɔːl ɪn wˈɒn daɪɹˈɛkʃən, and lˈiːvz ˈaʊt ðə hˈeə and ðə swˈɛt ɡlˈandz.

lines.text: We call a closed wound healed, as good as new. But pulled until it tears, even an old scar holds only about four-fifths of the original strength.
lines.phonemes: wiː kˈɔːl ɐ klˈəʊzd wˈuːnd hˈiːld, az ɡˈʊd az njˈuː. bˌʌt pˈʊld ʌntˈɪl ɪt tˈeəz, ˈiːvən ɐn ˈəʊld skˈɑː hˈəʊldz ˈəʊnli ɐbˌaʊt fˈɔːfˈɪfθs ɒvðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl stɹˈɛŋθ.

lines.text: Yet until about the sixth month of pregnancy, a cut in a baby's skin regrows the weave, follicles and all. After that, it patches.
lines.phonemes: jˈɛt ʌntˈɪl ɐbˌaʊt ðə sˈɪksθ mˈʌnθ ɒv pɹˈɛɡnənsi, ɐ kˈʌt ɪn ɐ bˈeɪbiz skˈɪn ɹɪɡɹˈəʊz ðə wˈiːv, fˈɒlɪkəlz and ˈɔːl. ˈaftə ðˈat, ɪt pˈatʃɪz.

lines.text: And on most of your body, only the top layer, about this paper's thickness, grows back without a seam.
lines.phonemes: and ˌɒn mˈəʊst əv jɔː bˈɒdi, ˈəʊnli ðə tˈɒp lˈeɪə, ɐbˌaʊt ðɪs pˈeɪpəz θˈɪknəs, ɡɹˈəʊz bˈak wɪðˌaʊt ɐ sˈiːm.

lines.text: So, is a scar still skin? Skin's quick repair: strong enough to close, never the weave.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, ɪz ɐ skˈɑː stˈɪl skˈɪn? skˈɪnz kwˈɪk ɹɪpˈeə: stɹˈɒŋ ɪnˈʌf tə klˈəʊz, nˈɛvə ðə wˈiːv.

lines.text: Next: a deadly poison, in a frown. How much goes in?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ dˈɛdli pˈɔɪzən, ɪn ɐ fɹˈaʊn. hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ ɡəʊz ˈɪn?
